composition_label: Web research -> Structured extraction -> Behavioral personalization

construction.implementation_origin: Original integrated reference implementation written for this build

shared_schema.input: synthetic=true; exact hostname allowlist; HTTPS urls; URL-keyed fixtures with text XOR redirect; fields with name/label/type/required; timezone-aware now; optional history and ranking
shared_schema.core_fields: Required id/title/category strings and nonnegative numeric price; additional string/number/integer fields supported. source/score/explanation are reserved names.
shared_schema.output: status/schema_version/synthetic plus research.documents, extraction.records and behavior. CLI errors return status=error and error.
shared_schema.validation: One validate(stage, data) boundary shared by the pipeline; each consuming stage revalidates the upstream bundle.
shared_schema.spans: Half-open Unicode code-point offsets into preserved source text; not byte offsets.

cross_stage_handoffs: Research validates allowlisted URLs and offline redirect chains, preserving requested/final URL, retrieval chain, fixture timestamp, exact text and SHA-256.

Extraction consumes validated documents; escaped schema labels match case-sensitive line-start Label: value entries; duplicate labels fail. Values retain exact source spans and source URL/digest; absent or empty values are reported.
Behavior consumes validated extracted records; missing required fields exclude candidates. Extracted IDs associate history with category and candidate; provenance flows into recommendations.

behavior.retrieval: Offline synthetic fixture retrieval only. No network fallback. At most 10 URLs per redirect chain; cycles fail.
behavior.scoring: Event weight = action multiplier * 2^(-age_days / half_life_days); purchase multiplier 3, view multiplier 1. Score = candidate direct weight + category weight.
behavior.cold_start: No history referring to eligible extracted candidates: all scores zero, deterministic ascending ID order.
behavior.unknown_history: Ignored and counted. Future timestamps, unknown actions and naive timestamps fail validation.
behavior.tie_break: Descending unrounded score, then ascending case-sensitive product ID.
behavior.duplicates: Canonical duplicate requested URLs and duplicate eligible extracted product IDs fail.
behavior.purchases: Purchased products remain eligible; repeated history entries count as separate events.
behavior.errors: Malformed present typed values fail the pipeline; absent/empty fields produce missing reports. CLI validation/file failures emit one JSON object and exit 2.

excluded: HTML rendering or arbitrary document parsing

coverage: CLI success, file, JSON and schema errors
